# Nested selected-collection fixture

The uppercase asset/META.JSON declares nested textures and ../shared resources inside the explicit selected root. Scale/DC share one original; an unused original is declared twice. The private neighbor is not a group resource.

All WebP bytes and numeric goldens are reused unchanged from the independently constructed v2-sh3 packet. This tool changes only reference names, copies the original bodies and calculates SHA-256 framing from the documented splatview-source-v1 layout using Python hashlib/struct. No production loader or key helper supplies expectations.

The expected key covers all eight unique originals, including unused declarations. Outer picker/drop folder labels and unrelated neighbors are absent. Construction alone is not browser/native qualification.
